shared_elements: schematic frontal anthropomorphic figure or body
circular discs or ring motifs on/within the figure
paired round features flanking a central axis
justification: The strongest correspondence is that both include a highly schematic, front-facing anthropomorphic form organized around a vertical axis, with circular or ring-like motifs placed on the body area and paired round features to either side. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by a radial circular medallion with concentric borders, serrated outer edge, and repeated oval openings enclosing a small central figure, whereas B presents a single upright human-like body/stele with body markings and no surrounding circular frame.
